notes.title: Wings Demo available for Steam VR Fest!
notes.content:
Ready to fly?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37914529/fdae4975ef3d6dff891335900bce1f54f89b5e00.png

Have you ever had a dream where you could fly? This is one of those dreams. 

In this demo, you will experience a slice of what you can do with Wings. Learn a new innovative flight system where you flap your arms like a bird! 

In the full version of the game, the whole world is yours to explore online! Expect immersive flight, real world exploration, competitive racing, multiplayer gamemodes, MMO Open World features, and much more! 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37914529/1e579682c35aa3a188c9d64a5adcba2a8af3f50b.png
Special thanks to JoinUsInVR.com and all of my playtesters for providing feedback on the experience!

notes.title: Wings Playtest now available!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=6_gL64iYf64;full][/previewyoutube]
We're finally landing! 

After 2 more years of development, Wings is making its way back down into the hands of the VR community. 

"So, what took you so long?" 

Well, as I discovered, games take time. Thanks for your patience!

I want to make sure the experience runs well and is easy to navigate. I also want to verify the multiplayer works well with a larger group of flyers without performance drops. If you have and bug reports or feedback, join the Discord! This link won't expire ;)

Also, feel free to submit screenshots, videos, and all that kind of content. I added some camera options and the ability to record flight sequences. Would love to see what you all can do with wings! 

The playtest build will be available for the month of June.

Enjoy your flight!

notes.title: Gathering the Flock
notes.content:
Wings looks like a pretty casual experience, but learning how to fly is like learning a new sport! I will be working with a local VR business to teach people how to fly this evening. This is an opportunity to experience the multiplayer aspect of the game for anyone who wants to see other people taking flight. 

On a side note, I apologize for providing almost zero instruction on how to play my game. I will plan on making a tutorial video where I teach the basics and show off what you can do with your wings. In the meantime, here are some tips on how to fly and control your character!

The right joystick/touchpad lets you follow your flyer while touching it. Click it to toggle on and off. Clicking it at the top position will combine your player and flyer together. 
Your flight direction is entirely based on your wing positions. If you want to turn, move your arms! You can change your flight angle by tilting your wrists.
Keep your wings spread out! If they are in front of your face, you create less thrust and more drag. 
Don't flail your arms! An simple up/down motion with both hands is all you need to build speed and go up.
The quickest way to lose speed is to move your arms from back to front with your wings spread out and tilted toward the sky.
(Advanced) If you want to gain a huge speed burst, spread your wings out and tilt them towards the ground, move your arms front to back (a butterfly stroke), then bring your wings parallel to the ground and flap up/down to keep your altitude steady. 
If all else fails, think like a bird!



It's hard to learn this by telling you how to do it, so I hope you get to learn by example!

Also, I made a Discord server for anyone who wants to ask questions, report bugs, submit feedback, or post pictures of cats. Here's a link! 

Enjoy your flight!
~Kittyking101

notes.title: Learn To Fly!
notes.content:
Hello world,

This is a project I started working on 3 years ago. I wanted to create a VR experience where people learn to fly and explore an open world together. I found that most standalone VR games had limited movement options, so I wanted to break the mold and create the most dynamic movement system possible to simulate the dream of flight. I also wanted it to be multiplayer so people can connect with each other and show off their flying skills while they travel the world. 

After discovering WRLD3D's maps SDK in 2017, I was excited to use it as a testing grounds for flying. I was invited to participate in their WRLD Challenge: a global game jam for people using their platform. I ended up winning, so that was pretty cool. 

Wings is an experience for all ages and all backgrounds. I've had people as young as 6 and as old as 80 try it out; people with no VR experience and people actively involved with the gaming/VR industry. It's been awesome to hear their feedback, but now I'm looking forward to hearing from you guys playing on your own time. 

This is my first game published to Steam. I am hoping that this will help me open some doors in my life. For now, I just want to give people wings and see where they go. 

I hope you enjoy your flight! ːsteamhappyː

-Kittyking101
